status: PREDECLARED; no WBR training; conductor verifies augmented plant before training

baseline.evidence: SIMULATION / ASSUMED; no hardware or sim-to-real claim

plant_contract.status: 2026-10-20 published API read; implementation verification belongs to conductor
plant_contract.authority: Implemented actuator-worker config/API, checked consistently against this protocol before training; discrepancies need an explicit versioned amendment before any training or evaluation.
plant_contract.delay_rule: Represent 3/5 ms exactly; never round them to a 2 ms tick.
plant_contract.reset: Zero pending commands, realized/estimated motor torque and history; runtime owns separate noise RNGs.
plant_contract.integration: RK4 mechanics using exact interval-mean lagged torque; substeps <=0.00025 s; exact transport arrivals and torque-squared integrals; approximate coupled mechanics.

observations.sensor_semantics: Cached common measurement; noisy body angle/gyro, ideal translation/leg angle and their rates are explicit ASSUMED sensor proxies.
observations.causal_estimates: Two motor torque estimates reconstructed from issued commands and known delay/lag, never read from physical torque.
observations.history: Use runtime clipped command history newest first, length n=max(1,ceil(delay/control_dt)); right-pad to three pairs with zeros. Initial history is zero. Known delay determines n, no mask needed.
observations.known_context: Fixed delay shared with both controllers; lag is constant. No time/push schedule input.
forbidden: true physical state as policy/controller input

policy_input.normalization: Fixed divisors only, no clipping or fitted running normalization. Same information available to both; LQR undoes scaling, selects native history length, and may ignore extra fields.

push.location: body COM; world +x; no applied moment

acceptance.success: Full 10 s; no fall, displacement violation, numerical warning/reset or cap violation; full push impulse when applicable; all six true errors within tolerances throughout final 1 s; recovery within 5 s of t=0 or pulse end.
acceptance.recovery: Start of uninterrupted in-tolerance suffix through episode end, relative to t=0 or pulse end; require full episode and final 1 s held. Otherwise null plus failure reason.

negative_control.purpose: Plant sanity control; excluded from PPO-vs-LQR aggregation.

lqr.baseline: Existing nominal DARE gains from approved config; frozen across delay conditions; use measured common observation only.
lqr.fallback: Actuator worker's conditional delay-augmented DARE design is permitted only after observed frozen-baseline failure. Conductor freezes one named comparison baseline across all conditions before PPO training: nominal if every regime passes, otherwise conditional design for all regimes, using its predeclared delay-specific matrices. Retain/report original failures and all gains/hashes; no per-episode switching, weight search, or gain_schedule use/replacement.

training.policy_scope: One policy per seed, shared across all eight evaluation conditions.
training.condition_sampling: At each episode reset, uniformly sample one of four delays and one of two scenarios; no other randomization.
training.initial_states: Exactly the declared scenario states; no curriculum.
training.checkpoint_selection: Final checkpoint after exactly 150000 environment steps; no best checkpoint/seed selection; no early success stopping.
training.failed_seeds: Retain all attempts/logs/reasons and seed slots. Missing final policies score zero success; never invent trajectories or silently replace seeds.

rng.policy_seed_library: SB3 seed sets Python/NumPy/Torch/action-space RNG; runtime owns independent noise generators.
rng.training_noise: runtime.reset(seed=1000000 + 150000*policy_seed + episode_index); zero-based episode_index<150000, at least one step per episode.
rng.evaluation_noise: runtime.reset(seed=evaluation_noise_seed) for each condition/controller/policy seed; use declared held-out integers directly.
rng.runtime_streams: SeedSequence(seed).spawn(2), separate PCG64 body-angle/gyro streams; draw at reset and once after each completed control interval; repeated reads consume nothing.
rng.evaluation_draws: Same seed/tick innovations across controllers/policy seeds, including the shared prefix of failed episodes; no controller-dependent draws.

evaluation.pairing: Same noise seed list for every delay x scenario, controller and PPO policy seed; LQR panel may be reused, never counted as independent repeats.

ppo.action: Two independent Gaussian outputs; clip to Box[-1,1]^2 then multiply by [2,4] N m; shared plant applies delay and lag.

reward.equation: r[k] = -dt * (x[k+1]^T Q x[k+1] + u_cmd[k]^T R u_cmd[k]) - 100 * I(physical_failure)
reward.state: True post-step six-state error about zero; reward/evaluation only.
reward.torque: Bounded pre-delay command in N m; not an LQR residual.
reward.physical_failure: Fall or displacement violation terminates; numerical failure aborts and retains the failed training attempt, never supplies NaN reward.
reward.normalization: None; fixed dimensional sampled quadratic cost plus declared terminal penalty.

episode_end.terminated: Fall >=45 deg in either pitch or |x|>1.5 m; acceptance checks at control samples, matching existing evaluator; no between-sample acceptance claim.
episode_end.truncated: 10 s time limit, with terminal observation retained for value bootstrapping.
episode_end.numerical_failure: Retain failure reason, logs and partial trajectory; invalid training run cannot count as a full seed.

metrics.definitions: State RMSE uses true substep-start errors weighted by actual dt; command effort uses held clipped commands; applied effort uses runtime exact torque-squared integrals. Report elapsed duration so early failures cannot appear efficient. Peaks/final-window/recovery use control samples; push peak uses t>=3 s. Saturation is bounded command at a cap within 1e-12; include raw policy/LQR commands separately where accessible.
metrics.failure_reporting: Retain every seed/episode; conditional recovery only alongside failure counts. Assign penalized recovery 10 s to every unrecovered episode or missing final policy. Undefined physical metrics stay null with reason; no fabricated falls/torques for missing policies.

aggregation.within_seed: Average 20 paired noise episodes per condition; then equally average eight conditions for primary endpoint.
aggregation.across_seeds: Report all five seed values, mean, sample SD and two-sided 95% Student-t interval mean +/- t(0.975,4)*SD/sqrt(5). Apply to seed-level PPO-minus-LQR paired differences; do not treat 800 episodes as independent training replicates.
aggregation.lqr_uncertainty: One 20-noise-seed panel per condition; no training-seed variance or duplicated-panel sample-size inflation.
aggregation.missing_metrics: All-seed continuous summaries are undefined if any seed lacks physical data; available-only diagnostics require explicit denominator and failure counts.
aggregation.primary_endpoint: Equal-weight success-rate difference PPO minus LQR across eight conditions.
aggregation.claim_rule: No RL superiority claim without measured primary paired 95% CI entirely above zero, all five complete budgeted seeds, and full failure/secondary tables. Per-condition/secondary comparisons are descriptive; no post-hoc winner selection.
aggregation.interval_scope: Training-seed uncertainty conditional on this fixed held-out noise panel; no universal robustness claim.

smoke.label: SMOKE ONLY
smoke.ci: Protocol tests and tiny backend smoke only; never substitute truncated budgets for actual comparison runs.

provenance.output: New external run directory per attempt; preserve failures, partial runs and logs; no artifacts in git.
